import os,sys
REV=int(sys.argv[1]); ENV=sys.argv[2]; HOST=sys.argv[3]
hist='/app/config-history'
revs=sorted(int(d[1:]) for d in os.listdir(hist) if d.startswith('r'))
def getfile(path):  # absolute under /app/config
    rel=os.path.relpath(path,'/app/config')
    for r in revs:
        if r>REV:
            p=f'{hist}/r{r:04d}/prev/{rel}'
            if os.path.exists(p): return open(p).read()
    return open(path).read()
def read(path,name,cfg):
    sec=None
    for line in getfile(path).splitlines() if path.startswith('/app/config') else open(path).read().splitlines():
        l=line.strip()
        if not l or l.startswith('#'): continue
        if l.startswith('['): sec=l[1:-1]; continue
        k,v=[x.strip() for x in l.split('=',1)]
        if k=='include':
            if sec is None:
                p=os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(path),v.replace('${env}',ENV).replace('${host}',HOST)))
                read(p,name,cfg)
            continue
        if sec is None or sec==name: cfg[k]=v
for s in sorted(os.listdir('/app/services')):
    cfg={}
    read(f'/app/services/{s}/service.conf',s,cfg)
    n=cfg.get('name',s)
    pb=cfg.get('port_base');po=cfg.get('port_offset')
    main=int(pb)+int(po) if pb and po else None
    print(s,n,'enabled=',cfg.get('enabled'),'main',main,'admin',cfg.get('admin_port'))
EOF
